newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Incentive opens 2 new U.S. clinics.
newsitem.headline: Incentive opens 2 new U.S. clinics.

text.p: Swedish holding company Incentive AB said on Thursday the U.S. unit of its medical technology arm Gambro was opening two new dialysis clinics in the U.S. and entered in a cooperation agreement with a third.
Incentive said Gambro Healthcare Patient Service was opening clinics in Denver, Colorado and Goldsboro, North Carolina.
The clinics can serve about 100 dialysis patients.
Gambro Healthcare Patients Services was already operating a clinic in the Denver area and another two clinics in Goldsboro, Incentive said in a statement.

Incentive said an established dialysis clinic in Niagara Falls, New York, had entered into a cooperation agreement with Gambro under which the clinic is being provided with medical knowledge and administrative services.
